title: Winter and Bell
author: Astrid Kavanagh
blurb: Zephyrine Thackeray, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
